title: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius (SNES) - School (Library)
description:
One of the backgrounds seen in the second stage of Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius for the Super Famicom. Compared to the old version in the site, this one is more optimized and has better palette organization.

A good fit for school levels, in general.
